newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian average o/nite rates rise at start of wee.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian average o/nite rates rise at start of wee.

text.p: Average overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose at the start of the week to between 10 1/8 and 10 1/4 percent on Sunday from between 9 7/8 and 10 1/4 percent on Thursday, bankers said.
Average one-week rates were slightly lower, at between 10 1/8 and 10 3/8 percent, compared with between 10 1/4 and 10 1/2 percent on Thursday, they said.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
